pnkk.b1: 13 validation stages covering 8 leave types (Labor Code 2019 Arts. 112, 115; Social Insurance Law 2024); every failure maps to one of 30 error codes.

pnkk.b3: An LLM agent parses natural-language requests, drafts escalations for the right approver and processes their reply; annual leave up to 2 days auto-approves when rules pass.
pnkk.b4: FastAPI/SQLite backend, 3-mode web app (Staff, Manager, Test), Docker Compose, 225 automated test functions and a 37-case correctness suite.
